sections.text: Introduction

These procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
operation and calibration of AT31 relay.

It is recommended this procedure be carried out an yearly bases the first 
preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activates required 
prior to testing.

The first draft is imitated 
and tested by eng. Mostafa Hasas, accepted by general director 
eng. Farag Abo Yousef, approved by eng. Abd El-Mohsen Abd El-Ghafar.

This document revised by 
eng. Mona Ahmed Elsharkawy: WDEP inspection & quality control'shead sector and MPIS coordinator.

sections.text: Test Steps

items: Connect the current test set terminals to point (7-10) for phase R
Connect the timer test set terminal to point (23-24)

Inject the current for phase R then increase the current gradually until the 
 red flag for phase R appears then record IR (pick - up) and record the time

Decrease the current gradually until the red flag disappear then record IR 
 (reset)

For find the time for trip increase the current until the timer red flag 
 appear them record the time for trip

For phase S repeat steps from (1) to (5) connect the current test set to point 
 (8-11)

For phase T 
 repeat steps from (1) to (5) connect the current test set to point (9-12)
